candidates.description: Hasbro's stock jumped 10% this week after Play-Doh, the 70-year-old kids' toy, finally cracked the adult market. The company's new Blooms line lets grown-ups build flower arrangements out of dough-based kits, and it sold out in 24 hours on TikTok Shop after Hasbro tried the exact same concept six years ago and watched it flop. Mattel's stock is down 28% this year to a $4B valuation, meaning Hasbro is now worth three times its longtime rival. So what did Hasbro change the second time around to turn a failed product into a sellout? candidates.description: StubHub CEO Eric Baker built his company's reputation on being a neutral marketplace for fans, but SEC filings just revealed he also runs a hedge fund that bankrolls the same scalpers who dominate his platform. A class-action lawsuit filed this week accuses Baker and StubHub of deceptive practices after thousands of World Cup ticket holders were left stranded outside stadiums with tickets that never existed. We break down how a ticket bought for $100 can net a scalper 400% to 1,000% profit, and why StubHub might be less referee than player.
